description: Bridge summary for one state: total bridges, counts by condition (Good/Fair/Poor), posted and closed counts, scour-critical count, average year built, total deck area. Without a state, returns per-state totals with condition counts for all states. Read-only; no API key. Data is the FHWA NBI 2025 annual snapshot. Use get_county_summaries instead for the per-county breakdown within a state, list_posted_or_closed_bridges or get_worst_bridges for bridge-level problem lists, and search_bridges for individual bridge records.
name: get_state_summary
